title: Halo Theme (Mjolnir Mix)
artist: Martin O'Donnell & Michael Salvatori feat. Steve Vai

drums.tags: Cinematic orchestral score with a focus on tension and suspense. The arrangement features staccato string ostinatos in the cellos and violas, punctuated by low brass swells from trombones and tubas. A high-pitched, dissonant violin tremolo creates a sense of unease. Percussion consists of deep orchestral bass drum hits and metallic anvil strikes. The tempo is 85 BPM in 4/4 time. The piece is in the key of D minor. Woodwinds, specifically bassoons and contrabassoons, double the low string lines for added texture. The dynamics shift from a quiet, brooding piano to a sudden, aggressive fortissimo climax with rising brass glissandos and rapid snare drum rolls.

bass.tags: Industrial metal with heavy electronic influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted, syncopated riffs alongside a thick, overdriven synth bass. The drum kit features a mechanical, processed snare and a punchy kick drum. High-pitched, dissonant synth leads provide melodic accents. The track utilizes aggressive, shouted male vocals with heavy distortion and saturation. Tempo is 130 BPM in the key of D minor. The arrangement features sudden dynamic shifts between dense, wall-of-sound textures and stripped-back rhythmic sections. Industrial sound effects, including metallic clangs and digital glitches, are integrated into the percussion.
